result:
**C round 227: PASS.** Every acceptance row was checked in real Chromium at 1440×900 and 1280×720, so `browserVerified` and `realVerified` are true. I made no source edits. The full suite, build, lint, verify and e2e smoke are left to the root gate and are not claimed.

**What I verified:**
- **Scope:** HEAD is still `80fbb3b` and exactly 10 paths are changed. All hash lists match, the protected files are clean, and A's edits stay inside the five grants. A's two extra assertions (D1) are in the one granted test case.
- **Unit tests:** the 3 changed-code test files pass (63 tests). The fixed test case no longer checks any class names. SC4 exists, and only the UC12 title changed.
- **Shortcut sheet:**
  - All 43 rows match the round-226 table, with only the `fit` and `waveform-zoom` rows changed, at both viewports.
  - Search results match round 226, and the new words work (`ruler` finds `fit`, `menu` finds `waveform-zoom`).
  - Each chip fits on one line and the sheet doesn't overflow sideways.
  - The footer button and `?` open the sheet, and Esc returns focus to the footer button.
- **Fit behaviour (pixels per second, 1440 / 1280):**

  | State | Action | Zoom change | Result |
  |---|---|---|---|
  | Nothing selected | Ruler double-click | 11→4.5 / 9.1→3.7 | Fits the whole project |
  | Any | Overview double-click | 11→4.5 / 9.1→3.7 | Fits the whole project |
  | Time selection | Ruler double-click | 4.5→35.5 / 3.7→24.2 | Zooms to the selection |

- **Waveform zoom:** the control is a `<select>` named "Waveform Zoom…". Setting it to 2× shows the "view only" status.
- **Layout:** element positions are identical to round 226. The footer stays 49 px. The selected-clip line and the lane-move messages stay one 16 px line in the same row as the Shortcuts button.
- **Auth:**
  - `/studio/middle-east` shows "Sign in required" with no audio.
  - `/api/studio-token` without a header returns 401. A fake token gets a 500 (no backend in the cloud), and no token is issued.
  - A fresh `/studio-lab` shows the demo badge with no stored login.
- **Export:** the WAV is 24-bit, 48 kHz stereo, 4,864,896 frames, with loudness segments identical to round 226. There were 0 page errors throughout.

**Two Low findings for B:**
- **C-R227-01 (wording):** the chip says "Double-click the ruler (no selection)". But with a clip selected and no time selection, the double-click still fits the project. "(no time selection)" would be exact; A's code reviewer flagged the same thing.
- **C-R227-02 (doc):** doc 177 lines 74 and 109 still say "SC1–SC3", and its changed-files list leaves out `track-layout.test.tsx`. Those lines were outside A's grant, so this isn't A's fault.

**Notes for B (not findings):**
- A's D1 check that the footer row has exactly 2 children will break if CALM-2 or CALM-3 change that row. Those rounds need `track-layout.test.tsx` in their pre-check and test set.
- The `fit` row in the sheet is now 64 px tall instead of 42 px, because its two chips sit on two lines.

Files are in `/home/runner/czaba-project/tmp/studio-real-loop/`:
- `c-round-227.md`
- `c-round-227.json`
- `c-round-227/` (scripts, screenshots and measurements)
